versions.content: The port mirror configuration shall be enabled and disabled, respectively, per Ethernet Switch by calling EthSwt_SetPortMirrorState . The current state of the stored port mirror configuration shall be stored persistently, to out- last an ECU reset and to restore the port mirroring activities after an ECU reset.
